_why_skip_macro: The MACRO (cycle) fib is a deliberate fork and cannot pass. mpc_jarvis.pine reworked its anchor on 2026-07-31; this engine still matches sos_fade_strategy.pine, which is the file the bot actually replays (Aaron's call). Revisit ONLY when the rework reaches the strategy file, at which point the 1-minute source becomes an architectural decision, not a port.
